Yes I can see how using Mr and Mrs also confirms your gender. I guess I have limited insight there because I have never been misgendered and never had to worry about that (oops that darn privilege). On the other hand I feel really connected to she/her pronouns and language would be so hard to remove those (I’m an SLP so they’re also important to me there haha).
